drugs.name: DT-enabled personalized nutrition, activity, and sleep

mechanism_of_action: Digital twin technology predicts postprandial glycemic responses to personalize nutrition, activity, and sleep; the source states postprandial hyperglycemia drives insulin resistance and inflammation.
primary_endpoint: Change in HbA1c and medicine reduction between groups at 1 year.
efficacy_outcome: At 1 year, HbA1c decreased by 2.9 (SD 1.8) with DT versus 0.3 (SD 1.2) with standard care (P < .001); T2D remission with DT was 72.7%. In participants with abnormal baseline values, NAFLD liver fat score changed by −2.5 (SD 2.0) versus −0.1 (SD 1.5), and NAFLD fibrosis score by −1.20 (SD 0.9) versus −0.1 (SD 1.0), both P < .001.
